template.name: sequentia/subscription-escrow

params.label: Asset the subscription is paid in
params.name: PAY_ASSET

params.label: Issuer key, which releases the raise or cancels the subscription
params.name: ISSUER_KEY

params.label: SHA256 of the scriptPubKey the raise is released to
params.name: ISSUER_SCRIPT

params.label: Least the release pays the issuer, in the payment asset: the offering's minimum
params.name: MINIMUM

params.label: Close: a block height below 500,000,000, or a unix time at or above it, from which the issuer may release
params.name: CLOSE

params.label: SHA256 of the subscriber's refund scriptPubKey
params.name: REFUND_SCRIPT

params.label: Deadline, a height or a time as CLOSE is, from which anyone may refund the subscriber
params.name: DEADLINE

params.label: Most a refund may keep back for its fee, in the coin's asset
params.name: FEE_CAP

params.label: The subscription this coin pays, which gives each one its own address
params.name: SUBSCRIPTION

paths.effect: Spends the coin into any transaction ISSUER_KEY signs once CLOSE has passed (OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY), provided output 0 pays ISSUER_SCRIPT at least MINIMUM of PAY_ASSET, explicitly and with no nonce. Every subscription's coin names the same output 0, so one release spends them all and output 0 carries the raise; the minimum is a floor on that one output.
paths.name: release

paths.effect: Spends the coin, at input k, into any transaction ISSUER_KEY signs, provided output k returns the coin's own asset to REFUND_SCRIPT, explicitly and with no nonce, holding at least the coin's value less FEE_CAP. The issuer refunds a subscription early with it.
paths.name: cancel

paths.effect: Once DEADLINE has passed (OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY), anyone spends the coin, at input k, provided output k returns the coin's own asset to REFUND_SCRIPT, explicitly and with no nonce, holding at least the coin's value less FEE_CAP. Needs no signature, so the subscriber is refunded even if nobody else acts.
paths.name: refund

template.summary: Holds one subscription's payment: the issuer takes it, with every other subscription, once the offering has closed and the release pays at least the minimum; the issuer may refund it at any time, and after a deadline anyone refunds it to the subscriber.

release.transaction: two subscriptions' coins released together, a fee coin in another asset; the raise at output 0, the fee change and the fee

cancel.transaction: one coin cancelled back to its subscriber, a fee coin; the refund, the fee change and the fee

refund.transaction: two coins refunded by anyone after the deadline, each fee kept back from its coin; two refunds and the fee
